rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that works well or is currently valid and in force, including a measure that becomes effective immediately.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 zan1 hai6 jau5 haau6

rows.note: Use this when a speech, argument, or action is powerful and makes a strong or decisive impression rather than merely functioning successfully.

example.english: Their speech was very effective and made everyone change their minds.
example.traditional: 佢嗰番說話好有力，令大家都改變咗睇法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 faan1 syut3 waa6 hou2 jau5 lik6 ling6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 goi2 bin3 zo2 tai2 faat3
